source: Native AWS CLI using scripts/aws/aws_cli.py run/result

findings.finding: The same policy delivered String blue, String.Array containing blue, and Number 5; String 5, Number 0 and Number 11 were bounded non-observations.

Native SNS admitted and delivered isolated prefix, suffix, equals-ignore-case, anything-but and anything-but-prefix matches under attribute $or branches. Corresponding mismatches were bounded non-observations. String.Array [bad,good] delivered under anything-but [bad], agreeing with documentation examples but not its contradictory none-of-array prose.

Attribute exists:true delivered the present String. Missing key and empty String.Array were bounded non-observations. Empty String publish was rejected with ParameterValueInvalid. Attribute exists:false delivered missing-key with another attribute; zero attributes and present-key cases were bounded non-observations.

Nested MessageBody matching delivered numeric-array leaf and same-object array-entry matches. Split conditions across separate array objects, wrong leaf and empty object were bounded non-observations.

Body exists:true delivered present string, empty string and null. This conflicts with current official non-null/non-empty prose. Missing field, empty array and empty object were bounded non-observations; no long-term guarantee inferred.
Each body $or branch delivered with the required parent source; no branch and parent-source mismatch were bounded non-observations.

All ten malformed/unsupported admission shapes returned native InvalidParameter HTTP 400. Singleton-object and literal-value $or were rejected rather than treated as ordinary field names, contrary to the broad fallback wording in current OR docs.
Both policies were admitted with HTTP 200 and read back. Delivery matching for these two compositions was not exercised.

unresolved_edges: Bounded windows are not a negative-delivery oracle; documented filter additions can take up to 15 minutes.
Body exists:false, numeric String.Array elements, inclusive upper-bound equality, precision limits, wildcard/cidr, filter complexity ceilings and signed-envelope verification were not exercised.
Admitted anything-but-suffix and prefix/equals-ignore-case nesting have admission evidence only.

limitations: Every absence is a bounded non-observation, not proof of permanent rejection or non-delivery.
Official SNS documentation allows up to 15 minutes for additions or changes to filters; initial Subscribe attributes avoid updates but do not remove that documented consistency caveat.
Sequential exact subscriptions on one topic/queue avoid duplicate-endpoint identity and update propagation. No SetSubscriptionAttributes calls.
String anything-but documentation contains contradictory array prose versus examples; mixed-array observations retain native results without treating prose as an oracle.
No EventBridge operator parity assumed. Admission-only cases do not establish delivery matching.
SNS signed notification Body strings and signatures are retained without normalization; raw CLI debug and secret-bearing request headers are discarded.
One account/region; no FIFO, HTTP, email, SMS, mobile, KMS, topic-deletion semantic, or CloudWatch experiments.

prior_evidence.use: Existing crossed attribute/body evidence motivates typed/nested/operator distinctions; not copied as new native observations.
